description: This file contains shell script functions related to managing eMMC partitions, formatting, mounting, and firmware upgrade procedures specific to the uDPU device platform within the OpenWRT project.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks and sets up the eMMC device based on available device nodes.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Prepares a specific partition by unmounting it if necessary.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Validates existing partitions and creates new ones if missing.

methods.name: udpu_do_misc_prep
methods.description: Prepares the /misc partition, mounting and formatting as needed.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Sets up essential partitions with appropriate filesystems during initial setup.

methods.name: udpu_do_regular_upgrade
methods.description: Performs cleanup and preparation tasks for a regular system upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Main upgrade function that manages firmware extraction, partition preparation, and update steps.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_uDPU
methods.description: Copies configuration files from backup storage to the /misc partition.
